topic: Starting small: Rs 500 or Rs 1,000 a month

slides.headline: Your future self will thank today's small SIP
slides.subhead: A fixed amount every month builds a habit that grows with you.

points.title: Time helps
points.text: The earlier you begin, the longer your money can stay invested.

points.title: Habit over amount
points.text: A steady monthly SIP builds discipline you can increase later.

points.title: Your money adds up
points.text: ₹1,000 × 12 months × 10 years = ₹1,20,000 invested. For illustration only.

slides.headline: Start small. Stay steady.
slides.cta: Save this for your next family money chat
slides.footnote: For illustration only. Not advice on any scheme.

caption: Starting small is still starting. A fixed monthly SIP builds a habit that can grow as your income does. Begin with an amount that feels comfortable. #SIP #MutualFunds #StartSmall #Chennai #MoneyHabits
